note: A pair is 一双皮鞋; for sports shoes, 运动鞋.

examples.zh: 我想买一双黑色的皮鞋。
examples.en: I want to buy a pair of black leather shoes.

examples.zh: 这双皮鞋穿着很舒服。
examples.en: These leather shoes are comfortable to wear.

examples.zh: 面试的时候，最好穿皮鞋。
examples.en: It's best to wear leather shoes to an interview.

note: Opposite: 收入. Noun: 每月支出; verb: 支出费用.

examples.zh: 这个月我的支出比收入多。
examples.en: My spending this month is more than my income.

examples.zh: 家里最大的支出是孩子的学费。
examples.en: The family's biggest expense is the child's tuition.

examples.zh: 你每个月支出多少钱？
examples.en: How much money do you spend every month?

note: Describes the form of things: 不同形态, 水的三种形态.

examples.zh: 水有三种形态：冰、水和气。
examples.en: Water has three forms: ice, liquid and vapor.

examples.zh: 这种病在不同的人身上形态不同。
examples.en: This disease takes different forms in different people.

examples.zh: 现在的工作形态和以前不一样了。
examples.en: Work today looks different from before.

meaning: weak; thin (of a link or foundation)

senses.en: weak; thin (of a link or foundation)

note: Of abilities, defenses, links, awareness: 薄弱环节.

examples.zh: 我的英语基础比较薄弱。
examples.en: My foundation in English is rather weak.

examples.zh: 哪个部分最薄弱，我们就先练习哪个。
examples.en: We practice first whichever part is weakest.

examples.zh: 这家医院的管理还很薄弱。
examples.en: This hospital's management is still weak.

note: Opposite: 晚期. Medical: 癌症初期.

examples.zh: 病在初期，吃药就能好。
examples.en: The illness is at an early stage, so medicine will cure it.

examples.zh: 公司初期只有五个人。
examples.en: In its early days, the company had only five people.

examples.zh: 这个项目的初期工作很难。
examples.en: The early work on this project is hard.

note: 污水处理 = sewage treatment.

examples.zh: 工厂的污水不能直接流进河里。
examples.en: The factory's sewage can't flow straight into the river.

examples.zh: 这个城市新建了污水处理厂。
examples.en: This city has built a new sewage treatment plant.

examples.zh: 河里的污水看起来很脏。
examples.en: The dirty water in the river looks filthy.

note: What makes a thing or material what it is: 药的特性.

examples.zh: 每种材料都有自己的特性。
examples.en: Every material has its own characteristics.

examples.zh: 你了解这种药的特性吗？
examples.en: Do you know the properties of this medicine?

examples.zh: 猫有一些很特别的特性。
examples.en: Cats have some very special characteristics.

note: Often 不耐烦地 + verb, or 很不耐烦.

examples.zh: 他等了半个小时，开始不耐烦了。
examples.en: He waited half an hour and started to get impatient.

examples.zh: 她不耐烦地说："你怎么还没好？"
examples.en: She said impatiently, "Why aren't you ready yet?"

examples.zh: 别对孩子这么不耐烦。
examples.en: Don't be so impatient with the child.

note: Math, science, and also set patterns: 数学公式.

examples.zh: 这个公式我记不住。
examples.en: I can't remember this formula.

examples.zh: 老师在黑板上写了一个公式。
examples.en: The teacher wrote a formula on the blackboard.

examples.zh: 用这个公式，你可以找到答案。
examples.en: With this formula, you can find the answer.

note: Shops and equipment: 品种齐全, 设备齐全.

examples.zh: 这家超市的东西很齐全。
examples.en: This supermarket is well stocked.

examples.zh: 房间里的设备齐全吗？
examples.en: Is the equipment in the room complete?

examples.zh: 我们的材料已经齐全了。
examples.en: Our documents are now all complete.

note: 办公桌 is an office desk.

examples.zh: 我的书桌上有很多书。
examples.en: There are many books on my desk.

examples.zh: 孩子需要一张新书桌。
examples.en: The child needs a new desk.

examples.zh: 他每天都坐在书桌前学习。
examples.en: He sits at his desk to study every day.

note: Wave to call a taxi or say hi: 招手叫车.

examples.zh: 他向我招手，让我过去。
examples.en: He beckoned to me to come over.

examples.zh: 在路边招手，出租车就会停。
examples.en: Wave at the roadside and a taxi will stop.

examples.zh: 孩子在车上向我们招手。
examples.en: The child waved to us from the car.

note: Of phones, machines, the earth.

examples.zh: 我的手机一直在振动。
examples.en: My phone keeps vibrating.

examples.zh: 机器一开，桌子就开始振动。
examples.en: As soon as the machine starts, the table begins to vibrate.

examples.zh: 你感觉到地面在振动吗？
examples.en: Do you feel the ground vibrating?

note: Parents' view of their grown children: 儿女双全, 儿女情长.

examples.zh: 他们的儿女都在国外工作。
examples.en: Their children all work abroad.

examples.zh: 父母总是为儿女担心。
examples.en: Parents always worry about their children.

examples.zh: 你有几个儿女？
examples.en: How many children do you have?

note: Pattern: 公认(的) + noun, or 被公认为 X.

examples.zh: 他被公认为最好的医生。
examples.en: He is widely recognized as the best doctor.

examples.zh: 这是公认的事实。
examples.en: This is a universally acknowledged fact.

examples.zh: 北京烤鸭是公认的美食。
examples.en: Beijing roast duck is a widely recognized delicacy.

note: Government or company allowances: 交通补贴, 住房补贴.

examples.zh: 公司每个月给我一笔交通补贴。
examples.en: The company gives me a transport allowance every month.

examples.zh: 政府补贴买电动车的人。
examples.en: The government subsidizes people who buy electric vehicles.

examples.zh: 这个补贴可以拿多久？
examples.en: How long can you receive this subsidy?

meaning: all over the body; a whole outfit

senses.en: all over the body; a whole outfit

note: 一身汗 (sweaty all over), 一身新衣服 (an outfit).

examples.zh: 他跑回来，出了一身汗。
examples.en: He ran back and was sweating all over.

examples.zh: 她穿了一身红色的衣服。
examples.en: She wore an all-red outfit.

examples.zh: 孩子玩儿了一天，一身都是土。
examples.en: The child played all day and is covered in dirt.

meaning: to maintain; to take care of (body or goods)

senses.en: to maintain; to take care of (body or goods)

note: Cars, skin, machines: 汽车保养; body: 保养身体.

examples.zh: 车每半年要保养一次。
examples.en: The car needs servicing every six months.

examples.zh: 她的皮肤保养得很好。
examples.en: She takes very good care of her skin.

examples.zh: 年纪大了，要注意保养身体。
examples.en: As you get older, you need to take care of your health.

note: A project or problem to study or solve: 研究课题, 重要课题.

examples.zh: 我的课题是关于老人健康的。
examples.en: My research topic is about older people's health.

examples.zh: 这个课题需要三年时间。
examples.en: This project will take three years.

examples.zh: 环境问题是现在的重要课题。
examples.en: Environmental problems are an important issue now.

meaning: to increase in size; to enlarge

senses.en: to increase in size; to enlarge

note: Used for size and degree: 增大压力, 增大难度.

examples.zh: 工作增大了他的压力。
examples.en: Work has increased his stress.

examples.zh: 风越来越大，声音也在增大。
examples.en: The wind is getting stronger, and the noise is growing too.

examples.zh: 我们要增大对教育的投入。
examples.en: We need to increase investment in education.
